articles.summary: Every subscription business running on Stripe has felt the sting of a failed payment. A customer who loves your product, uses it daily, and never intended to leave—suddenly churned. Not because they wanted to cancel, but because a credit card expired, a bank flagged a transaction, or funds were temporarily short. This is involuntary churn, and it is one of the most overlooked revenue leaks in SaaS and eCommerce. Failed payments account for a massive share of total subscriber losses across industries. According to Stripe's own Billing report, 43% of businesses don't even know how much revenue they've lost due to involuntary churn or payment failure—yet 72% say fighting churn remains a top priority. The disconnect is staggering, and the opportunity for recovery is enormous.
